records.Name: Unisanta — Academic Service Platform
records.Technologies__c: Apex, LWC, Flow Builder, Omni-Channel, Einstein Bots, Custom Metadata Types
records.Description__c: Implemented Service Cloud and Education Cloud so academic operations and student support run on a single Salesforce platform, with Apex, LWC and Flow Builder.
records.Problem__c: Student support and academic operations were split across channels, making SLA control and routing inconsistent.
records.Solution__c: Centralized case intake (Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case), Omni-Channel queues, Einstein Bots for triage and Entitlements/Milestones for SLA escalation.
records.Architecture__c: Service Cloud + Education Cloud. Routing rules driven by Custom Metadata. REST integrations in Apex with Named Credentials and 90%+ test coverage. Deploys via Salesforce CLI and Git.

records.Name: Real Grandeza — Sales and After-Sales
records.Technologies__c: Apex, LWC, SOQL, Flow Builder, Validation Rules, REST, SOAP
records.Description__c: Delivered the commercial funnel in Sales Cloud and after-sales support in Service Cloud for a pension-fund client.
records.Problem__c: Lead capture, qualification and conversion were manual, and after-sales cases lacked consistent routing.
records.Solution__c: Lead-to-Opportunity pipeline with follow-up Flows, LWC components for registration/service, Validation Rules, Apex triggers and REST/SOAP integrations.
records.Architecture__c: Sales Cloud for the funnel; Service Cloud for case routing. LWC + Apex/SOQL for UI. Triggers and integrations for after-sales automation.

records.Name: Micromed — Partner Self-Service Portal
records.Technologies__c: Experience Cloud, Knowledge, Apex, Flows, Data Loader, Dashboards
records.Description__c: Launched an Experience Cloud self-service portal for customers and partners, backed by a Knowledge base to deflect human cases.
records.Problem__c: Customers and partners opened cases for questions that could be resolved with structured content.
records.Solution__c: Experience Cloud (Communities) portal integrated with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, plus Knowledge articles and data categories.
records.Architecture__c: Experience Cloud site on Sales/Service data. Knowledge with data categories. Apex and Flows for portal processes. Data Loader and dashboards for content operations.

records.Name: Salesforce Portfolio App
records.Technologies__c: Apex, LWC, Flow Builder, Named Credentials, Custom Metadata, GitHub Actions
records.Description__c: Personal portfolio rebuilt as a native Salesforce app: custom objects, layered Apex, a live GitHub LWC and publication automation. Agentforce is added on top of the same invocable Apex.
records.Problem__c: A résumé alone cannot prove Apex architecture, LWC, integrations or test discipline to a Salesforce hiring manager.
records.Solution__c: A deployable SFDX app with a real REST callout, trigger handler, Flows with split responsibilities, 90%+ tests and CI.
records.Architecture__c: LWC githubRepos → GitHubReposController → GitHubService → Named Credential + CMT. Trigger → Handler → SalesforceProjectService. PortfolioProjectInvocable and GitHubReposInvocable for Flow and Agentforce.
